text:
anya: noticed weird bump in per-tenant embedding costs this morning around 03:15 UTC. heatmap shows spike on the embed route.
mike: did we flip any sampling or telemetry flags overnight?
anya: yes, telemetry team enabled broader preflight sampling to catch rare dim combos (0.2% -> 2%).
zara: that explains it. more preflights -> more detected mixed-dim batches -> splitter multiplies internal requests.
ben: can we confirm splitter amplification metric? quick grafana link?
ops-bot: query: splitter_invocations / sampled_requests = 2.9x for impacted tenants between 03:00-04:00 UTC. top tenants: tenant-gamma, tenant-delta.
mike: short-term mitigation: decrease sampling for trial-tier tenants and roll canary back to 0.5% global. who can toggle?
anya: I can flip canary. doing rollback for trial-tier now.
anya: /toggle-config telemetry.preflight.sample_rate=0.005 --scope=trial
ops-bot: config change applied; monitoring for 30m.
ops-bot: post-change metrics: splitter amplification down to 1.4x; cost delta reduced ~45% vs peak.
zara: good. long-term we need smarter logic so telemetry doesn't produce multiplier side-effects. proposal: an estimator API that returns a cheap cost/probability without invoking splitter.
ben: sketch?
zara: minimal API: POST /v1/embeddings/preflight/estimate {num_inputs, avg_bytes, dims_hint} -> {est_units, prob_split, est_confidence}. should be O(1) and run in <5ms p95.
mike: console UX: show "est. token units" in preview and a yellow badge when prob_split > 0.6 with suggested fixes (smaller batch, dims_hint). pm asked for that.
anya: telemetry: store estimator prediction ids on requests to compute accuracy. sample predictions at 1% to bound storage. need obs quota bump?
ops-bot: rough calc: sampling predictions at 1% increases telemetry DB by ~10% monthly. file ticket to observability if we go beyond POC.
ben: routing policy: use estimator to route to either fastpath (no split) or split-slowpath. also add a fallback to route to compatible quantized model if split cost high.
zara: important: estimator must be conservative (bias toward predicting split) to avoid underestimating load. make bias configurable per-tenant.
mike: rollout plan: canary estimator in us-west for 50k requests, compare predicted vs actual split. require precision >= 0.9 and estimator latency <5ms.
anya: automation: add an auto-revert trigger: if splitter amplification > 2.0 within 2h of config change, revert sampling rate and notify on-call.
ops-bot: alert rule created (id: S-7701): splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 120m after telemetry config change.
ben: console: also show a changelog banner when sampling configs change for 24h so finance/CS aren't surprised. put a link to the runbook.
mike: I'll draft API PR and include microbenchmarks + synthetic mixed-dim workload. tagging @zara for estimator heuristics.
zara: will add estimator telemetry fields and the conservative bias flag in the PR.
anya: capturing follow-ups: API PR (mike), telemetry calc + obs ticket (zara), console mock + banner (ben), auto-revert rule (ops-bot).
mike: thanks. quick note: include header X-Estimator-Id on requests so we can correlate traces.
zara: noted. we'll also add estimator accuracy dashboard in console.
ops-bot: monitoring job scheduled for canary window. will post summary after 1h.
anya: thanks team. will update the incident doc and ping CS with temporary mitigation notes. :thumbsup:
